lead.title: NVIDIA opens DGX Spark to eight-unit clusters with 1TB of pooled unified memory
lead.summary: At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA enabled manual clustering of up to eight DGX Spark GB10 units over ConnectX-7, pooling as much as 1TB of unified memory — enough to run frontier-class open models like GLM 5.3 on a desk. The 64GB DGX Spark ($4,999) ships from Acer, ASUS, Dell, GIGABYTE, HP and MSI on Friday, October 23, while the 128GB model has climbed to $6,950 amid the memory crunch. NVIDIA also announced llama.cpp and vLLM optimizations — up to 1.4x faster agentic tasks on RTX PRO 6000 — plus day-zero support for Nemotron, GLM, DeepSeek, Qwen, MiniMax and FLUX.3 and a new FP4 checkpoint collection.

top_stories.title: AMD and Intel will build a single PyTorch code path for AI inference on CPUs
top_stories.summary: AMD's ZenDNN optimizations will be folded into Intel-led, UXL-governed oneDNN as the default x86 acceleration library for PyTorch CPU inference, with both vendors jointly advancing the ACE matrix-multiply ISA.

top_stories.title: Year-old AI lab Flapping Airplanes raises $1B at a $6B valuation
top_stories.summary: A $1B Series A co-led by Index Ventures and Lux Capital for the San Francisco frontier lab building models that learn from far less data on its own GPU megakernel framework; no commercial product yet.

top_stories.title: Legal AI startup Legora raises $550M Series E at an $8.8B valuation
top_stories.summary: Led by Atreides Management at an $8.8B post-money valuation, up from $5.6B, with Fidelity, Capital Group and J.P. Morgan joining Accel, Benchmark and ICONIQ as the agentic legal platform expands across North America, Europe and APAC.

top_stories.title: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3.5 Embed, Rerank and Parse as open retrieval models for agents
top_stories.summary: The three open retrieval components — embedding, reranking and document parsing — are positioned as building blocks for agentic systems, with NVIDIA claiming world-class retrieval performance.

items.title: SPARE allocates MoE sparsity by routing entropy instead of pruning every layer equally
items.summary: An MoE expert-pruning method that sets per-layer sparsity from routing entropy, cutting the memory footprint that blocks MoE deployment on local hardware.

items.title: Right On Q recovers reasoning in quantized LLMs via self-generated trajectories
items.summary: A quantization-aware training recipe that supervises the low-bit student on its own reasoning trajectories instead of fixed full-precision responses, where standard QAT struggles.

items.title: UlaCache keeps sparse-attention KV caches available without pinning them in memory
items.summary: A unified logical addressing layer for sparse LLM serving that retains what decoding still needs and frees the rest, cutting long-context serving memory cost.

items.title: RCSD trains speculative-decoding drafters with reinforcement and continual learning
items.summary: Replaces soft-label distillation against the target's full output distribution with RL and continual learning for draft models, improving acceptance rates for domain-specific inference.

items.title: PACE quantizes linear-attention recurrent states to four bits with channel-aligned encoding
items.summary: Compresses the fixed-size recurrent state of linear-attention models so more concurrent sequences share an accelerator than prior state-quantization schemes.

items.title: NVIDIA and UW Medicine's Institute for Protein Design release open protein-design model RFD4-Proteina
items.summary: Announced at GTC Berlin, the BioNeMo model co-developed with the David Baker Lab covers seven design tasks — from motif scaffolding to antibody design — with weights on Hugging Face and code via RosettaCommons.

items.title: NVIDIA introduces Alpamayo 2 Edge, a 2B open reasoning VLA model for vehicles
items.summary: A compact 2-billion-parameter reasoning model for real-time scene understanding and motion planning, built on Cosmos and optimized for DRIVE AGX Thor, extending the commercially-licensed Alpamayo family for on-vehicle inference.

items.title: Liquid AI ships DSpark, a speculative-decoding draft model for LFM2.5-24B-A2B
items.summary: A 327.7M-parameter drafter that averages 2.4x output throughput at concurrency 1 (up to 3.1x) on a B300 in SGLang for 656 MB of extra weights — a direct local-serving speedup for last week's on-device agent model.

items.title: Omnara is an open-source, self-hostable alternative to Claude Managed Agents
items.summary: A Show HN launch of a managed agent platform positioned against Anthropic's Claude Managed Agents and OpenAI's Agents API, with the repo under active development.

items.title: QAmcp tests any MCP server in one command, with deterministic checks instead of AI judging
items.summary: A new CLI and GitHub Action that exercises tools, safety labels, hidden-instruction detection, bad inputs, leaked secrets, OAuth, resources and prompts.

items.title: Renor gives coding agents a private memory shared across tools over MCP
items.summary: An AGPL-3.0 memory layer that stores notes as Markdown files in a local folder and recalls them later over MCP, shared across agent tools.

items.title: VoxScribe brings offline Whisper voice typing to Android and Windows
items.summary: Free, open-source dictation that types speech into any app using on-device Whisper, with no cloud and no account.

items.title: Ollama v0.40.8 ships support for Recursive's Flint coding model
items.summary: Flint is a 40B Apache-2.0 MoE coding model (~2.5B active, 262K context) reporting 54.9% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 74.2% on SWE-bench Verified; GPU support outside macOS is slated for a later release, and a v0.40.9-rc1 followed on October 22.

items.title: n8n 2.45.1 fixes a worker queue-job lock race and adds migration-findings triage
items.summary: The pre-release patch also repairs a Microsoft Teams Trigger Graph subscription renewal bug and lets workflow editors triage upgrade-migration findings on their own workflows.

items.title: Community n8n node classifies text without an LLM, API key, or subscription
items.summary: n8n-nodes-jeffy replaces the Text Classifier node with logistic regression — deterministic, no JSON-parsing failures — shipping 70 pretrained classifiers that run on a free public endpoint or self-hosted on CPU.

items.title: DGX Spark October 2026 software update adds Wi-Fi Assistant and Linux 7.0 support
items.summary: The rolling update brings an appliance-mode Wi-Fi Assistant, dynamic display memory carveout, cloud-init provisioning and unified system software for both 64GB and 128GB configurations, with DGX Spark Skills arriving via NVIDIA Sync later this month.

items.title: Micron's Taiwan union launches a one-day strike threatening DRAM and HBM output
items.summary: The Taoyuan union called a strike for October 22 over bonus and profit-sharing terms, a stoppage that lands while DRAM prices are surging and supply stays tight well into 2027.

items.title: DRAM prices seen rising 20% QoQ in 4Q26 as PC DRAM supply set to contract next year
items.summary: TrendForce reports vendors widening Q4 contract hikes with DDR5 spot extremely tight, as bits shift toward server/HBM — continuing to raise prices for RAM and VRAM on local-AI rigs.

items.title: Samsung and SK Hynix upgrade Chinese fabs for advanced RAM as AI demand strains supply
items.summary: Both memory makers are moving China plants toward more advanced chips to meet AI demand and fend off rising Chinese rival CXMT, per a Reuters report, with knock-on effects for the global DRAM price picture.
